messages.text: BL-2116 🎵 in progress — Non-vacuity probe slice 1 of 3 (split from BL-1743): a shared test helper builds a probe's broken copy of a script under a temporary root of its own, at its repo-relative path with the real tree's other entries symlinked around it so relative loads resolve, and the next probe reaps any root a dead run left; bl1652, the file whose killed run littered seven worktrees, uses it
